subject: Onboarding access choreography — SSO/SCIM, service accounts, IP allowlist preflight
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Tom Harris <tharris@finity.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 15:04:00 +0000
Subject: Onboarding access choreography — SSO/SCIM, service accounts, IP allowlist preflight

Tom —

Thanks again for committing to the Redwood Dedicated trial. Before the implementation call next week, I want to make sure we have a tight preflight so engineering doesn't get blocked mid-cutover. High-level asks below; Marissa/Monica, please chime in with anything I miss.

What we need from Finity before cutover (short):
- SSO details: IdP metadata (SAML 2.0), SSO ACS URL, Entity ID, certificate (PEM).
- SCIM: API token with the minimum required scopes and an example user payload.
- IP allowlist: CIDR ranges for Prod and Staging, and whether you expect NAT IP changes during maintenance windows.
- Service accounts: list of service accounts that need RBAC in Redwood, and owner contacts.
- Org policies: any emergency-exempt groups (e.g., SOC ops) or conditional access constraints we should be aware of.

I've attached a short preflight checklist to capture the items above. Please upload the metadata and tokens to the secure folder (link below) or reply with the files.

Next steps: if you can get the IdP metadata and SCIM token to us by Wednesday EOD (US), Marissa can run a dry-run in our staging environment on Thursday. Monica will handle service-account provisioning and RBAC mapping.

- Sergio

Attachment: sso-scim-preflight-checklist.xlsx (xlsx)
Secure folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4Finity-Onboard
From: Tom Harris <tharris@finity.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: onboard-support@finity.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 20:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Onboarding access choreography — SSO/SCIM, service accounts, IP allowlist preflight

Sergio —

Appreciate the clear list. We can gather most of that quickly. A few clarifications:
1) Our IdP metadata is generated by our security team; we can produce the metadata XML and cert but need to redact internal hostnames. Is that OK for staging?
2) For SCIM, we have a token-scoped service account. Do you need admin-level SCIM or just user read/write?
3) IP ranges: our Prod egress is currently 3 CIDRs and we plan a maintenance window on Friday that could rotate one NAT IP. We'll flag you if that happens.

I'll have the security lead (onboard-support@finity.com) upload the metadata and a scoped SCIM token by Wed EOD. If you need the token shared via DocuSign or the Redwood secure transfer, let me know.

Thanks,
Tom
Product Ops — Finity Payments
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Harris <tharris@finity.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Onboarding access choreography — SSO/SCIM, service accounts, IP allowlist preflight

Tom —

Short answers inline and a couple of technical notes for your security lead:

1) Metadata redaction: staging can accept redacted hostnames but we need the SAML certificate and valid ACS/Entity ID values; placeholders in the XML break validation. If redaction is required, please provide a test IdP instance or the full metadata to our secure folder with a note.

2) SCIM scope: for onboarding we require user create/update/delete to sync groups and licenses. Read-only won't be enough for our default provisioning flows. If you prefer a safer posture, we can run with read/write and elevate to delete only after go-live signoff.

3) IP rotations: fine — please include the expected maintenance window and the designator for the NAT that might change. We'll add a conditional SLO on our side to avoid rollout during that window.

Operational checklist I ran through locally:
- Verify Redwood SP entity configured in IdP (SAML)
- Confirm SCIM token with the above scopes
- Confirm SCIM user schema mapping (we prefer email, externalId, groups)
- Provide service-account list for RBAC (CSV is easiest)
- Confirm emergency exempt groups and retention policy expectations

Monica — could you prepare the RBAC template and an initial service-account mapping CSV? I attached the preflight again.

—Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Onboarding access choreography — SSO/SCIM, service accounts, IP allowlist preflight

Tom / team —

Attached is a starter CSV for service-account mapping. Column headers: account_name, suggested_role, owner_email, notes. A few practical notes:

- Recommended roles: admin-readonly, app-deployer, billing-viewer, svc-infra (for SCIM/tokens).
- If Finity wants to map existing IAM groups to Redwood roles, include group IDs in the owner_email column or add a mapping column.
- For the SCIM user schema, our provisioning expects email as the primary key. If you use externalId, indicate that in the mapping file.

I'll spin up a staging RBAC config on Thursday after we receive the SCIM token. If you want me to create the initial service accounts in staging, I can do that once all owners confirm.

Attachment: service-account-mapping.csv (csv)

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success — Redwood Inference

Thanks all — good momentum. Tom, appreciate you lining up the security lead. Quick summary and next milestones: 

1) Finity to upload: IdP metadata XML + cert, SCIM token (scoped for create/update), and CSV of service accounts to the secure folder by Wed EOD (16 Jun).
2) Redwood: Marissa will validate SAML metadata and run a staging dry-run Thurs 17 Jun; Monica will provision staging service accounts and apply RBAC.
3) Cutover plan: assuming dry-run is clean, target cutover on Mon 21 Jun with a 2-hour window in the morning PST. We'll provide a rollback procedure and health checks.

If anyone needs a short sync before Thursday, propose Wed 17:00 UTC — 30 minutes.

Sergio
